title: SOUTHAMPTON'S PLAYOFF WIN WIPED OUT. THEN THEY STARTED ON MINUS FOUR
description:
Three spying breaches, a lost playoff win, a minus-four start. All in plain sight.

Southampton admitted spying on opponents three times last season. One analyst was sent to watch Middlesbrough before a playoff semi-final. The EFL noticed, overturned their playoff win, and the appeal failed. Hull won the final instead.

This season Southampton began on minus four points. Manager Tonda Eckert was fined £28,000 and kept his job. On the pitch, Saints beat QPR 4-1 in front of more than 30,000.

Was the punishment fair, too harsh or too soft? Tell us where you stand.
